instruction: Change the screen blank timeout to 15 minutes in power settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened GNOME Settings, navigated to Power panel, used terminal gsettings commands to list available power keys, found idle-dim, and set it to false. Successfully disabled dim screen when inactive.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open GNOME Settings, navigate settings panels, use terminal gsettings commands to read/write system settings, list available gsettings keys
metadata.task_rationale: Same power settings domain with a specific non-default value. Agent must set screen blank to 15 minutes (900 seconds) which requires understanding the mapping between UI labels and gsettings values.
metadata.explanation: Task requires setting screen blank delay to 15 minutes (idle-delay=900). Evaluator checks gsettings value. Config pre-sets idle-delay to 300 (5 min) so agent must change it to 900.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.session idle-delay to read the screen blank timeout value
Expected value 'uint32 900' correctly represents 15 minutes (900 seconds) in gsettings output format
exact_match metric correctly accesses rules['expected'] and compares with getter output — proper parameter handling for type='rule'
Config pre-sets idle-delay to 300 (5 min), ensuring agent must actively change the value to pass
Single instruction requirement (set screen blank to 15 min) is fully covered by the evaluator
